title: T Extended Weakly Contractive, Kannan, and Geraghty Mappings Fixed Points, Equivalences,
summary: We develop a unified T-extended framework for weakly contractive, weakly Kannan, and Geraghty classes of self-maps S on a metric space (X, d), where distances are measured on the auxiliary image via d(Tx, Ty), and the dynamics is governed by the composition of T and S. Under standard assumptions on the auxiliary map T (continuity, injectivity, subsequential convergence), fixed point theorems and Picard convergence are established for each class.
